title: Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance**
**Location :-**
Coimbatore
  
  
**Experience :-**
4+ Years
  
  
*Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading Life Sciences organizations strengthen quality compliance, ensure regulatory readiness, and drive operational excellence through robust document management and quality systems.*
**Your Role**
As a
**Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance**
, you will support the administration and execution of controlled quality documents across their lifecycle. You will ensure document accuracy, compliance with QMS procedures, audit readiness, and effective coordination between document owners, reviewers, approvers, and stakeholders in a regulated Life Sciences environment.
  
  
**In this role, you will:**

* Execute new document creation, revisions, periodic reviews, publication, archival, retirement, and document lifecycle activities.
* Review documents for formatting standards, template compliance, metadata accuracy, version control, and completeness.
* Initiate, maintain, and monitor QMS workflows while coordinating with document owners, reviewers, approvers, and training teams.
* Maintain document control records, document numbering systems, workflow status, repository data, and audit trails.
* Track open requests, SLA commitments, and due dates, escalating risks and bottlenecks as required.
* Support document retrieval, traceability, regulatory inspections, audits, and evidence preparation activities.
* Generate KPI/SLA reports, backlog metrics, compliance dashboards, and process status reports.
* Ensure adherence to document management procedures while protecting data integrity and record accuracy.

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Medical Sciences, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of experience in Document Control, Document Management, Quality Operations, Regulatory Support, Compliance, or related functions.
* Mandatory experience in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Medical Device, Healthcare, Medical, or other regulated industries.
* Hands-on experience within Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Systems (QMS), or regulated operational environments.
* Strong understanding of controlled document lifecycle management, records management, audit readiness, and data integrity principles.
* Experience working with Electronic Document Management Systems (eDMS) or controlled repositories such as:

+ Veeva Vault
+ MasterControl
+ OpenText / Documentum
+ TrackWise
+ Equivalent QMS/eDMS platforms

**About Us**
*At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From life sciences and healthcare innovation to advanced engineering solutions, our experts provide unique R&D and engineering services across industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities where you can make a difference every day.*

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

title: Labour Welfare & Employee Relations Lead
description:
**Responsibilities**
Act as the designated Labour Welfare Officer for the Coimbatore plant, ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws. Ensure statutory welfare facilities are available and maintained. Maintain statutory records and support inspections. Maintain strong shop-floor presence and employee connect. Identify early employee relations risks. Handle employee grievances fairly and timely with recommended countermeasure and follow through. Support disciplinary processes through fact-finding. Lead investigations while ensuring confidentiality. Manage contract labour welfare and compliance.- Support industrial harmony and workforce stability.
- Identify recurring employee relations themes (discipline, absenteeism, conduct, communication
****gaps, etc.) and recommend corrective and preventive actions.****

* Conduct targeted capability-building sessions for supervisors and frontline leaders to strengthen

****grievance handling, respectful workplace practices, and fair discipline.****
****Ethical & Safe Workplace (POSH)****

* Ensure effective implementation of the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) framework at the

****Plant.****

* Support Internal Committee functioning, ensuring statutory timelines, documentation, and

****confidentiality.****

* Drive periodic awareness sessions for employees and supervisors to reinforce respectful workplace

****standards.****

* Monitor trends (if any) and recommend preventive interventions to strengthen workplace safety and

****inclusion.****
**Essential**
****Required Skills / Qualifications****
Bachelor’s degree in HR / IR / Labour Welfare or related field. 8–10 years plant-based ER or labour welfare experience. Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws. Experience managing shopfloor and contract labour.- High integrity and strong interpersonal skills.
****Preferable****
Tamil Nadu manufacturing experience. Exposure to disciplinary enquiries and POSH.- Formal ER or labour welfare training.
**Who Is Gilbarco Veeder-root**
Gilbarco Veeder-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. For over 150 years, Gilbarco has earned the trust of its customers by providing long-term partnership, uncompromising support, and proven reliability. Major product lines include fuel dispensers, tank gauges and fleet management systems.
  
  
**Who Is Vontier**
Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.
  
  
Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.
  
  
With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com
  
  
**At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment.**
Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future.
  
  
Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally.
  
  
**Together, let’s power the way the world moves!**

title: Liaisoning Executive
description:
**We Are Hiring**

**Job Title**

**Liaisoning Executive With 1+ Years**

**Location**

Chennai

**Industry**

Solar, Wind Power & Renewable Energy

**Qualification**

Any Degree / Diploma 

**Work Timings**

9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

**Job Overview:**

To coordinate with Electricity Board (EB) officials and other government departments to obtain necessary approvals, complete documentation, and ensure the timely execution and commissioning of solar projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with TANGEDCO/TNPDCL offices for solar project approvals.
* Handle applications related to feasibility approvals, net metering, meter installation, and commissioning.
* Follow up with EB officials to ensure approvals are obtained on time.
* Prepare, submit, and track required documents and application forms.
* Coordinate with project engineers, customers, and internal teams for EB-related requirements.
* Arrange site inspections and coordinate with concerned officials.
* Maintain project-wise records of applications, approvals, and pending activities.
* Identify approval-related delays and report them to the management.
* Visit EB offices and project sites as required.
* Ensure all liaisoning activities are completed professionally and in compliance with applicable procedures.

**Skill Set Required:**

* Basic understanding of electrical systems and solar projects.
* Knowledge of EB documentation and approval procedures.
* Good communication and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and email.
* Willingness to travel to EB offices and project sites.
* Ability to manage multiple applications and deadlines.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred for field visits.

title: Patent Office Associate @ Coimbatore
description:

* Managing Patent Applications from University Researchers from filing of application until grant.
* Reviewing and analysing applications for patentability, novelty, completeness, and commercial potential.
* Interfacing with Researchers on their Applications and answering queries as and when they arise.
* Working with our Lawyers on applications from Prior Art Evaluation, drafting, filing and post filing documentation including prosecution

* File Management, Email monitoring, Prior art searches, and Documentation Management.

title: Design for Environment - Regulatory Product/ Material Compliance Engineer
description:
* Manage and validate IMDS submissions and supplier material declarations, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Conduct material and substance compliance assessments against IMDS, ELV, GADSL, REACH, RoHS, SCIP, and applicable global regulations.
* Perform early\-stage DfE and compliance assessments from innovation/concept gates through product launch.
* Identify material, substance, and regulatory risks and provide actionable inputs for material selection and design decisions.
* Assess compliance with PFAS restrictions, SVHC, REACH Annex XVII, Proposition 65, Conflict Minerals, and emerging regulatory requirements.
* Review BOMs, material compositions, technical documentation, and supplier evidence to establish product compliance status.
* Define and communicate DfE and material compliance requirements to Engineering, Procurement, Product Management, and Suppliers.
* Act as SPOC for customer compliance queries, questionnaires, regulatory requirements, and compliance evidence.
* Track regulatory changes and translate them into product, material, supplier, and design requirements.
* Develop Power BI, Excel/VBA, and automation solutions for compliance tracking, data validation, reporting, and process efficiency.



 Skills \& Experience
 


* Strong expertise in IMDS, ELV, GADSL, REACH, RoHS, SCIP, PFAS, SVHC, Proposition 65, Conflict Minerals, and global substance regulations.
* Strong understanding of material composition, restricted substances, thresholds, exemptions, regulatory applicability, and DfE principles.
* Proven experience in supplier/customer coordination, compliance assessments, risk identification, and integrating compliance requirements into product development.
* Proficiency in Power BI, Excel/VBA, automation, data analysis, Material Compliance/DfE; automotive experience preferred.
* Experience 6\+ years preferred



**Qualifications** 




 BE in Mechanical/ Automotive Engg/ Mechatronics
 



**Additional Information** 




 6 to 10 years
